name: Predictify
tagline: Turns prediction-market odds into daily tasks and hedges for Shopify merchants.
problem: Merchants react to news after it hits; the team argues prediction markets see disruptions earlier.
solution: Agents read prediction-market probabilities and translate them into store actions, delivered as a morning audio briefing; merchant approvals refine the agents, and on-chain hedging can lock margins.
demo_moment: Team-described: a 60-second audio brief tells a merchant what to change in the store today.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Shopify: Hack Shopping with AI” among 160 submissions.
Connects prediction-market signals to concrete merchant actions.
Stacks several sponsor technologies around one merchant story.

lessons: A sponsor prize favours a clear user (the merchant) with the sponsor's platform at the centre.
